result.instructions: Tools for Reviso, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customer invoices are overdue, and how much is outstanding per customer?"; "Show me all invoices booked to Schmidt & Co. this year."; "Create a draft invoice for customer 102 with 3 hours of product 110.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Reviso data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run reviso_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run reviso_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run reviso_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. reviso_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: reviso_get_company
tools.title: Get the connected company
tools.description: The connected Reviso agreement: company name, address, VAT number, bank details, base currency, VAT reporting frequency, agreement number and country type, the granting user and the app. Good first call. GET /self.

tools.name: reviso_list_customers
tools.title: List or search customers
tools.description: List customers with number, name, address, VAT number, currency, payment terms, VAT zone and balance. search matches the name (contains, case-insensitive); filter and sort take the raw Reviso syntax. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /customers.

email.description: Part of the customer's email address.

filter.description: Raw Reviso filter: predicates property$op:value joined by $and: / $or: (parentheses group), e.g. date$gte:2026-01-01$and:netAmount$gt:500. Operators $eq: $ne: $gt: $gte: $lt: $lte: $like: (contains; * wildcard) $in:[1,2]. Escape $ ( ) * , [ ] in values with a $ prefix. Only properties the collection marks filterable work (else HTTP 400).

sort.description: Sort by properties, comma-separated; prefix - for descending, e.g. -date,name. Only sortable properties work.

page.description: Page index, 0-based (default 0). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: reviso_list_invoices
tools.title: List sales invoices
tools.description: List sales invoices by state: drafts (not yet booked), booked (all issued), unpaid, paid, overdue, not-due. Each row has number, customer, date, due date, currency, net/gross/VAT amounts and remaining balance. Filter by customer_number and dates; filter and sort take the raw Reviso syntax. Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /v2/invoices/{state}.

date_from.description: Invoice date on or after this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

date_to.description: Invoice date on or before this day (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: reviso_get_invoice
tools.title: Get a sales invoice
tools.description: One sales invoice with its lines, recipient, payment terms and totals. A draft is addressed by its draft number (the id of a drafts row), a booked invoice by its bookedInvoiceNumber (the voucher number shown in booked, unpaid, paid, overdue and not-due rows). GET /v2/invoices/drafts/{n} or /v2/invoices/booked/{n}.

state.description: drafts for an unbooked draft, booked for an issued invoice (also paid/unpaid/overdue ones).

number.description: Draft invoice number (state drafts), or bookedInvoiceNumber (state booked).

tools.name: reviso_list_reference
tools.title: List reference data
tools.description: List one lookup table: customer-groups, supplier-groups, product-groups, payment-terms, payment-types, vat-zones, vat-accounts, currencies, units, layouts (invoice layouts), departments, employees, employee-groups, price-groups or country-codes. The numbers in these rows are what the create tools and invoices reference (customerGroupNumber, paymentTermsNumber, vatZoneNumber, layoutNumber, ...). Paged: pass next_page as page. GET /{resource}.

page.description: Page index, 0-based (default 0). Use next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: reviso_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a new customer in Reviso. Needs a name, currency and three reference numbers from reviso_list_reference (customer-groups, payment-terms, vat-zones). Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two customers, so search with reviso_list_customers first. Returns the new customer with its customerNumber. POST /customers.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR, GBP, DKK (reviso_list_reference with resource currencies lists them).

vat_zone_number.description: VAT zone number (reviso_list_reference, resource vat-zones): domestic, EU or abroad.

tools.name: reviso_create_supplier
tools.title: Create a supplier
tools.description: Create a new supplier in Reviso. Needs a name, currency and three reference numbers from reviso_list_reference (supplier-groups, payment-terms, vat-zones). Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two suppliers, so search with reviso_list_suppliers first. Returns the new supplier with its supplierNumber. POST /suppliers.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR, GBP, DKK (reviso_list_reference with resource currencies lists them).

tools.name: reviso_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a new product or service in Reviso. Needs a product number (your own code, unique), a name and a product group number (reviso_list_reference, resource product-groups). Not idempotent in effect: an existing product number is rejected by Reviso. Returns the new product. POST /products.

sales_price.description: Net sales price per unit in the base currency.

cost_price.description: Cost price per unit (ignored when the inventory module is on).

unit_number.description: Unit number (reviso_list_reference, resource units), e.g. each, hour.

tools.name: reviso_create_draft_invoice
tools.title: Create a draft sales invoice
tools.description: Create a DRAFT sales invoice for an existing customer. It is not booked and not sent: the user reviews, books and sends it in Reviso. Currency, invoice layout, payment terms and the recipient address are copied from the customer (override with the optional fields). Each line names a product_number and a quantity; the product's unit and sales price apply unless unit_net_price is given. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two drafts. Returns the new draft with its draft number. Makes up to 3 requests. POST /v2/invoices/drafts.

due_date.description: Due date, yyyy-mm-dd; only used by payment terms of type due date, otherwise Reviso computes it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR, GBP, DKK (reviso_list_reference with resource currencies lists them).

layout_number.description: Invoice layout number (reviso_list_reference, resource layouts); default: the customer's, else the agreement's default layout.

payment_terms_number.description: Payment terms number (reviso_list_reference, resource payment-terms); default: the customer's.

product_number.description: Product number (reviso_list_products). Its unit and sales price are used unless you override the price.

unit_net_price.description: Net unit price in the invoice currency; omit to use the product's sales price.

description.description: Line text; omit to use the product's name.
